subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text. 0.
stimulus: our national flag symbolizes freedom from foreign domination it is hoisted everywhere on the national days we respect our national flag we have a great honour to it many people sacrificed their lives for this flag. Part B : Composition (20 Marks)
guide_solution: Our national flag symbolizes freedom from foreign domination. It is hoisted everywhere on the national days. We respect our national flag. We have a great honour to it. Many people sacrificed their lives for this flag.
